__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages with an Erenshor link whose <code>stablekey</code> matches nothing in the game data. Often a game update renamed the thing.

To fix a page, choose the correct key with the '''Erenshor link''' button in the ''Insert'' group of the source editor, or remove the key. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Maintenance categories]].
